results.message: What did your bishops decide at Chalcedon about Christ's two natures?

voice_event.speaker: lpc
voice_event.text:
We were not at Chalcedon. We do not know what happened after our years, and we say nothing of any church that comes after us.

What we do hold about Christ is this. He is the only Son of God, our Lord, and that confession belongs to the one Godhead in three: Father, Son, and Holy Ghost. Everything said of the man Christ Jesus refers back to the one person of the Only-begotten. His death and rising are not facts we simply affirm and set aside. His crucifixion, burial, rising on the third day, ascension, and sitting at the Father's right hand were ordered so that our own life could be cut to their shape. We crucify our own flesh: that is his cross in us. We are buried with him in the water: that is his burial in us. We walk in a life made new: that is his rising in us.
